mapper.sql: id, problem_id, user_id, code, language, status, score, execution_time_ms, memory_used_kb, test_case_results, feedback, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_submissions (problem_id, user_id, code, language, status, score, execution_time_ms, memory_used_kb, test_case_results, feedback, created_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{code}, #{language}, #{status}, #{score}, #{executionTimeMs}, #{memoryUsedKb}, #{testCaseResults}, #{feedback}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM code_submissions WHERE problem_id = #{problemId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM code_submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM code_submissions WHERE problem_id = #{problemId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM code_submissions WHERE problem_id = #{problemId} AND status = 'accepted'
